answer: Cap influence per cluster instead of per account: validators group agents by attestation-graph overlap, and a cluster's total voting weight is the square root of its members. Ten clones inside one atlas of mutual endorsements add only 3.2 times the weight of one, so each extra fake yields less. Anyone can rerun the clustering from the public kernel of attestations every 20 epochs, and a mirror audit slashes 15% of any account hiding links.
